v.desc: A ColSec medical ship meant for triage and limited patrol work. It comes with a full chemistry lab with a small botany setup, and a special cell for treating/storing injured prisoners. Not suitable for long-term prisoner holding.
A cargo shuttle focusing on speed and comfort.
A luxury boat for a romantic getaway. It comes with a wall-to-wall swimming pool, sauna, a well-stocked bar and other amenities.

A small Avalonian vessel designed by the Illuminate to serve as a home for a small pack of two to three Avali. Comes complete with an efficient thermo-electric generator, cooktop, and a spacious bedroom.

A relatively new Illuminate design from Avalon for far flung colonies needing a multipurpose ship for salvage expeditions, cargo hauling, and other activities. Comes with a dedicated dock for the Nest for expanded pack functionality.
A sector security vessel designed for rapid deployment of high-explosive payloads.
A carrier designed to carry Mosquito-frame craft and other light vessels as well as provide heavy fire support.
A sector combat vessel meant to dish out heavy hits and tank them in turn.
A sector security vessel designed for boarding parties.
A sector security corvette designed to do most everything from patrolling to busting smugglers.
A medical configuration of the Mosquito boarding vessel
Custom-made for ColComm and licensed through the Jell Design Bureau, this fast and low-cost atmospheric harvester is frequently repurposed by mercenaries on a budget.

Designed and produced by SESWC. Heavily Upgraded from the Mayflower MKI. This expedition capable bounty hunter's ship offers two armories, a small medical treatment bay, an expand cargo bay, two confinment cells, captain's quaters and crew quarters with additional lattice protection.

A fairly old, yet reliable ship, formally issued to Peacekeepers involved in cross-corporate skirmishes. Its built to have everything a group of 3-4 might need to stay alive and relatively happy if such conflicts were to drag on for a while.
A small antique mining vessel, it's a wonder it's still in service. Sold by SESWC
A combat ship outfitted with 4 plasma turrets and 6 light autocannons. This ship has a military IFF designation.
A medium, syndicate-spec armoured medevac, SAR & boarding shuttle, with an armoury and frontal boarding ramp. Manufactured by Interdyne.
A medium, high-performance armoured medevac and search and rescue shuttle, with an armoury and frontal boarding ramp. Manufactured by Interdyne for the civilian market.
An RD-GCP hull retrofitted by Lumi-Raina Shipbuilders Incorporated to function as a 'spacefaring RV'.

Originally built as a tugboat for larger vessels operating in tight docking confines, the Gnat sports incredible maneuverability and speed with its size and oversized engines, at the expense of all other luxury. Oxygen not included. Built by Kestrel Stellar Foundries.
An old navy cruiser retrofitted by Lumi-Raina Shipbuilding Incorporated to run on a nuclear reactor.
A corvette equipped with missiles and a small holding cell. This ship has a TSF-SKR IFF designation.
An old torpedo bomber repurposed into the ultimate Botany vessel.  There's little you can't do with plants on the Verdure.
A fast brawler with heavy armor and ballistic armaments.
A small attack craft, ideal for dealing with small threats.
A tank with a layer of reinforced walls under its exterior hull, ensuring its able to send out obscene amounts of firepower.
Nobody expects the lowly barnacle
A tiny plastitanium vessel suited to a crew of 2 to 3 pirates. Has two broadside cannons and a rear-facing disposals launcher. Runs on plasma.
Rebuilt mining vessel made into a pirate ship with hangar bay to store vehicles, fits between 3-4 crew.
Mail is no longer an option: you either receive it or you die.
A small wooden ship with 2 central cargo bays.
Declassified gas production and distribution platform seized in a hostile takeover of an Atmosian conglomerate. For the ultimate insurgent.
A large luxury cruiser capable of long ranged travel acrossed the sector, expedition capable.
Civilian conversion of an old military light frigate from the early days of humanity's expansion to the stars, predating FTL technology. Manufactured by Langstad-Voigt Heavy Industries.

Originally built as a roll-on, roll-off transport for heavy terraforming equipment. Since its obsolescence and appearance on the secondary market, the Charon has become a favorite of upfitters for the broad possibilities afforded by its open equipment bay. A product of Endurance Industrial Shipyards.
Versatile expedition-capable multi-purpose light freighter.
Highly modular salvaging vessel welded together from smaller re-purposed hulls.

The Gasbender is a medium-sized engineering vessel outfitted for deep space construction projects. Features atmospherics setup with mixing/ignition chamber. Designed to work in pair with smaller salvage ship. Manufactured by Langstad-Voigt Heavy Industries.
The Gourd is a Science/Expedition vessel with a dedicated blast chamber.
Once a scout ship serving with the Nanotrasen Marine Expeditionary Forces, this now decommissioned expedition capable ship can be yours!
An agile multi-functional bounty hunting and expedition ship.
A light freighter often picked by bounty hunters due to its quick acceleration, expedition capable.
A small, fast salvage and expedition ship.
A fighter donned with dual laser weapons and high acceleration.
A medium size detective ship with facilities for autopsies, interrogations and detailed investigations.
Micro support vessel used for emergency rescues and first aid.
A large patrol vessel capable of carrying up to 4 smaller faster attack ships. The flagship vessel of the NFSD.
Micro attack vessel used for boarding and transport of prisoners.
A small detective runabout for intelligence gathering and forensic work.
A small security medical craft designed for emergency response and search and rescue operations.
A light medium ship with a recommended crew of 2 to 3 officers, the Hypnos is a dedicated interdiction vessel outfitted with a powerful EMP device for tackling escaping vessels.
A heavy corvette, the marauder class is a dedicated deep space patrol vessel outfitted with a powerful EMP device for capturing the common deep space pirate.
A small security assault craft designed for space combat equipped with an EXP-2100g mounted grenade launcher.
A medium-sized patrol craft, the Prowler class is a dedicated deep space pursuit vessel with an advanced sensor suite and missle armament.
Micro assault vessel with a toggle for going dark in deep space.
A small security assault craft designed for combat interdiction operations.
A large expedition oriented ship for holding prisoners and making them work planetside.
Whatever you're bringing, it won't fit. Seats two. Gravity included.
A cheaply made amalgamation of religious ships. For the seasoned religious assistant.
A flying hunk of wood and metal disguised as a kitchen shuttle. Not FDA approved.
A cargo slash salvage shuttle made from scavenged wrecks, comes with some damage.
Two wrecks welded together that are somehow capable of research.
A cheaply made mass-produced shuttle made from salvaged wrecks. For the seasoned assistant.
A cramped yet reliable shuttle for providing janitorial services.
A mobile office and personal transport for the Harbor Master, based on the BB Bodkin.
A small endurance shuttle for express logistics support in Frontier space.
A small tugboat. Manufactured by Langstad-Voigt Heavy Industries.
A cramped yet reliable shuttle for delivering packages.
A reliable shuttle for delivering mail and packages.
A refurbished and repainted older model of the NSF Templar for use for Mercenaries and 'repurposed' for the Station Guard, mind the gap.
A small armored Syndicate assault shuttle, perfect for devious operations!
A Syndicate nuclear operative infiltration ship.
A retired Cybersun 'Swordfish' torpedo bomber repurposed for hauling sensitive goods.
A small maneuverable shuttle designed for mining. Manufactured by Langstad-Voigt Heavy Industries.
A medium full-feature botanical research biodome equipped to help a botanist fully interact with their plants in almost any way conceivable.
A small medical and chemistry support vessel. Deployed by the Far Star Biotech company to provide aid and medical services to the Frontier.
A medium shipping vessel repurposed in a salvage and material exploitation vessel.
A small luxury cruiser for one or two people, with a lounge, a private bedroom, and a hell of a cockpit view.

The Bazaar is a personal service vessel designed to provide a platform for merchants to sell their goods, it features two locking cargo docks, a spacious cargo hold, and a mercenary post for shop security.
A fully functional Chemistry Lab. Perfect for the prospecting chemist or high school chemistry teachers. Yeah, Science!
A tiny food truck perfect for a solo chef.
The smaller sibling to the Broadhead, the BB Bodkin is designed for rockhopping and salvage recovery.
A cozy medium-size library for travellers who wish to relax with a book or perhaps a board game.
A medium mining vessel designed for deep space missions
A former humanitarian vessel, the Caduceus now works as the best mobile hospital money can buy.
A medical carrier produced by the Far Star Biotech corporation. Designed for large scale colonization support, humanitarian relief and post-disaster investigation and recovery operations.
A personal camper shuttle for those who prefer to live in emptiness of space.
A medium-size, high-class restaurant ship with ample seating, integrated botany and a dining room for VIP guests
Standard small-size vessel, originally meant to aid in ship scrapping, now modified to function as a multipurpose salvage/mining/cargo-hauling shuttle.
A mining and construction vessel intended to help build or repair quickly.
A technically spacefaring vessel.  No livery.
A compact cargo ship designed for hauling shipments.
The Crescent, named for its exterior shape, is a vessel focused on providing service, medical aide, and scientific breakthroughs for smaller vessels.
A spacious and inviting service ship. The crossroads is designed to help with dock crowding, connect communities, and serve as anchors for gatherings.

A medium service vessel providing botanical and chemical services to support the needs of the Frontier. Designed, developed and deployed by the Far Star Biotech company to render aid wherever it is needed.
A modern, medium-sized engineering & medical vessel. Focused on responding to shuttle distress, the Eagle comes equipped to restore most crew and shuttles to good health.
A small botany vessel dedicated to horiticultural experimentation.
A mobile engineering platform for deep-space repairs, upgrades and remodelling.
A medium sized vessel specializing in long-haul salvage, mining, and cargo operations.
HONK HONK HONK HONK HONK HONK
A medium research shuttle designed for xenoarcheological studies.
A medium-size, japanese-inspired restaurant/pub ship with a large dining area, and equally large kitchen.
Once a local shipping lane freighter, this model has been converted for use in debris field mining and salvage operations.
Spaceworthy bar/microbrewery with everything one needs to facilitate poor life choices: lots of booze, smokes, and lack of food. Manufactured by Langstad-Voigt Heavy Industries.
A small maneuverable shuttle with low operational costs for reporters who want to be first on a scene. Manufactured by Langstad-Voigt Heavy Industries.
A small shipbreaker/salvage vessel equipped with everything a small crew need for extended work shift in deep space. Manufactured by Langstad-Voigt Heavy Industries.
A compact cargo ship designed for hauling shipments.
A medium size science vessel with laboratories for both anomalous and xenoarchaeology research.
Your very own McCargo™ franchise! Comes fully stocked and ready for production of McMeals.
Fast food fast ship, bring the McCargo meals to the people
The Far Star Corporation's premier catering and service shuttle! Legally NOT a testbed for nutrient sequencing and biogenerative pattern research on humanoid physiology!
A ship designed as a mobile home, with space for user modifications. Fast and comfortable.
A research and salvage vessel designed for deep space exploration.
A combination animal ranch and pie bakery
A small psychology vessel. Named after the famous Placebo effect.
A small mining vessel designed to assist salvage operations.
A small transport shuttle with space for 4 passengers. Comes with the latest audio entertainment technology.

The Pulsar offers two robust polar work sites built around object retrieval and research circling a command hub. With a focus on safety, know that any catastrophic failures are entirely the fault of the operator! Brought to you by the Far Star Corporation.
A medium gas mining and engineering vessel designed and deployed by the Far Star Corporation to provide infrastructure support for deep space operations.
A small vessel outfitted for the search and recovery of wounded NT personnel. Manufactured by Langstad-Voigt Heavy Industries.
A small service ship with a full service kitchen and hydroponics garden.
A small research and engineering vessel.
A large, attractive but dated vessel with a pure focus on research and development. It is capable of generating anomalies.
The FSB Spirit is a search and rescue shuttle for experienced Frontier medics.

A medium medical vessel providing cryogenic and support medical services for the traumas of deep space operations. Designed, developed and deployed by the Far Star Biotech company to render aid wherever it is needed.
A mobile theatre perfect for putting on any show.
A budget mining and recovery shuttle for corporations unwilling to operate outside of a shoestring budget. Brought to you by the Far Star Corporation!
A small, agile lifeboat with an exterior deck and survivor cabin for search and rescue operations.
A adaptable long-haul industrial freighter that pilots have adapted to many different purposes.
A medium medical support vessel designed for cryogenic deployment.
